summary: Discover and book 5,000+ curated local experiences across 500 US destinations.
offersHint: Discover and book 5,000+ curated local experiences across 500 US destinations. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.greetwell.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_activities
toolsPreview.description: Read-only search for activities by location/query/date. Each result includes `booking_link`, `thumbnail_url`, `group_size`, and a standardized `item_card`.

toolsPreview.name: get_activity_details
toolsPreview.description: Read-only details for a single activity/product. Response includes `booking_link`, `thumbnail_url`, `group_size`, and a standardized `item_card`. Listing content fields (`additional_details`, `perfect_for`, `faq_items`) carry authoritative eligibility and logistics rules (e.g. minimum age, what to wear); check them before answering guest questions.

toolsPreview.name: get_activity_availability
toolsPreview.description: Read-only availability for an activity on a date (YYYY-MM-DD).

toolsPreview.name: get_complementary_recommendation
toolsPreview.description: Read-only ranked complementary activities anchored to a source product_id. Each recommendation includes `booking_link`, `thumbnail_url`, and a standardized `item_card`.
